lionheart_helm.name: LIONHEART HELM
lionheart_helm.desc: BELOW 40% HP: +25% DEF, AND A ROAR EVERY 3S DRAWS NEARBY FOES. WORN BY THE KING'S CHAMPION. IT ROARS. A LITTLE.

aegis_of_dawn.name: AEGIS OF DAWN
aegis_of_dawn.desc: EVERY 5TH HIT BRANN TAKES HEALS THE PARTY 8%. FORGED IN THE FIRST LIGHT OF ALDERMERE.

emberbrand.name: EMBERBRAND
emberbrand.desc: FIRE. SHIELD BASH SETS THE GROUND ALIGHT. THE BLADE NEVER QUITE STOPS SMOULDERING.

bulwark_of_aldermere.name: BULWARK OF ALDERMERE
bulwark_of_aldermere.desc: BLOCKS SHOTS FROM THE FRONT WHILE BRANN ISN'T SWINGING. A WALL WITH A HANDLE.

ember_circlet.name: EMBER CIRCLET
ember_circlet.desc: FIRE STATUSES LAST 50% LONGER. +8% CRIT. WARM TO THE TOUCH. WARMER TO THE THOUGHT.

phoenix_robe.name: PHOENIX ROBE
phoenix_robe.desc: ONCE A FIGHT, PIP RISES AGAIN AT 40% HP WHEN DOWNED. THE HEM IS ACTUALLY ON FIRE. DO NOT WASH.

sunspire_staff.name: SUNSPIRE STAFF
sunspire_staff.desc: FIRE. FIREBALL SPLITS INTO THREE WHERE IT LANDS. CARVED FROM A TOWER THAT IS NOT THE NINTH.

frost_grimoire.name: FROST GRIMOIRE
frost_grimoire.desc: CHILLS FOES HIT BY PIP'S SPELLS.

orb_of_echoes.name: ORB OF ECHOES
orb_of_echoes.desc: EVERY THIRD SPELL ECHOES AS A SECOND BOLT.

raven_mask.name: RAVEN MASK
raven_mask.desc: CRITS FROM BEHIND RESET SHADOW STEP. THE LAST THING MANY GOBLINS SAW. ALSO, BIRDS.

nightsilk_coat.name: NIGHTSILK COAT
nightsilk_coat.desc: DODGING LEAVES A SHADOW THAT DRAWS FOES FOR 2S. WOVEN FROM SHADOWS AND QUESTIONABLE DEALS.

wyrmfang.name: WYRMFANG
wyrmfang.desc: VENOM. POISON STACKS TO 7. STILL A LITTLE VENOMOUS. HANDLE WITH CARE.

wyrmfang_twin.name: WYRMFANG TWIN
wyrmfang_twin.desc: VENOM. WITH WYRMFANG: POISON SPREADS WHEN ITS TARGET DIES. THE WYRM WANTS THEM BOTH BACK.

widows_band.name: WIDOW'S BAND
widows_band.desc: FORTY YEARS ON ONE HAND. +25 HP, +2 DEF.

thornring.name: THORNRING
thornring.desc: SNAGTOOTH'S KNUCKLE-RING. REFLECTS 10% OF MELEE DAMAGE. +3 ATK.

bloodfang_axe.name: BLOODFANG AXE
bloodfang_axe.desc: 5% LIFESTEAL. REND STACKS BLEED TWICE AS FAST. STILL WARM FROM THE PIT.

gnasher.name: GNASHER
gnasher.desc: FIRE. LEAP LEAVES A BURNING CRATER. A DRAKE'S TOOTH, HAFTED.

quiver_of_embers.name: QUIVER OF EMBERS
quiver_of_embers.desc: FIRE. EVERY 4TH ARROW BURSTS INTO FLAME. SMELLS OF OLD SMOKESTACK.

clockwork_goggles.name: CLOCKWORK GOGGLES
clockwork_goggles.desc: HIDDEN CHESTS NEARBY SHOW ON THE MINIMAP. +6% CRIT. GIZMO'S PRIDE AND JOY.

mitre_of_good_cheer.name: MITRE OF GOOD CHEER
mitre_of_good_cheer.desc: OPTIMISM SHIELDS CAN REACH 30% HP. IT IS VERY HARD TO FROWN IN THIS HAT.

vestments_of_the_undimmed.name: VESTMENTS OF THE UNDIMMED
vestments_of_the_undimmed.desc: THE WHOLE PARTY REGENERATES 2% HP EVERY 5 SECONDS. THE STITCHING GLOWS FAINTLY AT NIGHT.

dawnhammer.name: DAWNHAMMER
dawnhammer.desc: LIGHT. SMITE LEAPS TO TWO MORE FOES. FORGED FOR A SAINT WHO HATED MORNINGS.

lantern_of_the_faithful.name: LANTERN OF THE FAITHFUL
lantern_of_the_faithful.desc: LIGHT. SANCTUARY WALKS WITH OAKE. THE LAMPLIGHTER'S LAST FLAME, STILL BURNING.

flameproof_overalls.name: FLAMEPROOF OVERALLS
flameproof_overalls.desc: IMMUNE TO THE CINDERREACH HEAT AND TO BURNING. SMELLS FAINTLY OF SCORCHED GNOME.

turret_mk2.name: TURRET MK. II
turret_mk2.desc: STORM. TURRETS FIRE LIGHTNING AND LAST TWICE AS LONG. MK. I IS NOT DISCUSSED.

vampires_kiss.name: VAMPIRE'S KISS
vampires_kiss.desc: HEALS 2% OF THE DAMAGE YOU DEAL. +10 HP. THE HOLLOW'S LAST BITE.

frog_signet.name: FROG KING'S SIGNET
frog_signet.desc: +15% GOLD FROM COINS AND CHESTS. +8 HP. IT'S A LITTLE DAMP.

echo_bell.name: ECHO BELL
echo_bell.desc: +20% ULTIMATE CHARGE. +2 ATK. IT RINGS, VERY FAINTLY, WHEN YOU'RE READY.

thunderwrench.name: THUNDERWRENCH
thunderwrench.desc: STORM. EVERY HIT SHOCKS. IT HUMS IN THE RAIN AND, ALARMINGLY, IN THE BATH.

ember_heart.name: EMBER HEART
ember_heart.desc: IMMUNE TO THE CINDERREACH HEAT AND TO BURNING. +12 HP. A COAL THAT NEVER GOES OUT.

hourglass_charm.name: HOURGLASS CHARM
hourglass_charm.desc: -12% SKILL COOLDOWNS. THE SAND FALLS UP, IF YOU'RE NOT WATCHING.

ward_shard.name: WARD SHARD
ward_shard.desc: +10% DAMAGE TO HEXED FOES. IT GROWS WITH EVERY WARD STONE THAT FALLS.

ward_prism.name: WARD PRISM
ward_prism.desc: +20% DAMAGE TO HEXED FOES. ONE MORE STONE, AND IT WILL BE A CROWN.

ward_crown.name: WARD CROWN
ward_crown.desc: +30% DAMAGE TO HEXED FOES. THREE STONES' WORTH OF BROKEN MAGIC, HUMMING.

traveler_compass.name: TRAVELER'S COMPASS
traveler_compass.desc: EVERY UNOPENED CHEST NEARBY SHOWS ON THE MINIMAP. GIZMO SWEARS IT ONLY POINTS AT TREASURE. MOSTLY.

wanderers_charm.name: WANDERER'S CHARM
wanderers_charm.desc: +8% MOVE SPEED. +10 HP. FOR SOMEONE WHO HAS CLIMBED EVERY TOWER.

laurel_sands.name: LAUREL OF THE SANDS
laurel_sands.desc: +12% DAMAGE WHILE THREE OR MORE FOES ARE CLOSE. +3 ATK. THE COLOSSEUM'S CROWD THREW IT FOR CLEARING WAVE 10. THEY LOVE A HERO IN TROUBLE.

gladiator_torc.name: GLADIATOR'S TORC
gladiator_torc.desc: EVERY FOE YOU FINISH HEALS YOU 4% OF YOUR MAX HP. +20 HP. FOR CLEARING WAVE 20 OF THE COLOSSEUM.

colosseum_crown.name: CROWN OF THE COLOSSEUM
colosseum_crown.desc: +8% DAMAGE. EVERY TENTH FOE THE PARTY FELLS, THE CROWD'S CHEER HEALS EVERYONE 8%. +6 ATK. FOR CLEARING WAVE 30.

phial_second_wind.name: PHIAL OF SECOND WIND
phial_second_wind.desc: POTIONS AND ELIXIRS HEAL 30% MORE. +15 HP. SMELLS LIKE MINT AND A SECOND CHANCE.

hawkeye_hood.name: HAWKEYE HOOD
hawkeye_hood.desc: HAWK STRIKE'S MARK MAKES FOES TAKE +20% (NOT 10%). YOU CAN SEE FOR MILES FROM UP HERE.

wolfskull_helm.name: WOLFSKULL HELM
wolfskull_helm.desc: HOWL ALSO GIVES THE PARTY +15% DAMAGE FOR 6S. GREYMAW WON'T BE NEEDING IT.

troll_hide_mantle.name: TROLL-HIDE MANTLE
troll_hide_mantle.desc: BELOW HALF HEALTH, REGENERATES 1% HP A SECOND (NOT WHILE BURNING). IT STILL TWITCHES SOMETIMES.

frostfur_tassel.name: FROSTFUR TASSEL
frostfur_tassel.desc: IMMUNE TO THE FROSTHELM COLD, AND TO CHILL AND FREEZE. +12 HP. A TRAPPER'S CHARM OF WHITE FOX FUR.

glacier_wand.name: GLACIER WAND
glacier_wand.desc: FROST. ICE SHARD SPLITS INTO THREE WHEN IT HITS. ISOLDE'S, ONCE. SHE'D WANT YOU TO HAVE IT. PROBABLY.

crown_of_rime.name: CROWN OF RIME
crown_of_rime.desc: FROZEN FOES SHATTER WHEN THEY DIE, CHILLING EVERYTHING NEAR THEM. COLD TO THE TOUCH. COLDER TO WEAR.

penitent_gown.name: PENITENT'S GOWN
penitent_gown.desc: WHEN AN ALLY GOES DOWN, THE WHOLE PARTY GETS A FROST SHIELD. WORN BY SOMEONE WHO HAD A LOT TO MAKE UP FOR.

galeheart_longbow.name: GALEHEART LONGBOW
galeheart_longbow.desc: STORM. POWER SHOT CHAINS LIGHTNING TO TWO MORE FOES. STRUNG WITH SOMETHING THAT HUMS IN THE WIND.

windrunner_leathers.name: WINDRUNNER LEATHERS
windrunner_leathers.desc: +10% MOVE SPEED. AFTER A DODGE, THE NEXT SHOT CRITS. FOUND WHERE ONLY THE WIND COULD TAKE YOU.

oathkeeper.name: OATHKEEPER
oathkeeper.desc: BULWARK LASTS TWICE AS LONG, AND WHEN IT ENDS THE SHIELDS BURST AND HEAL 30%. THE OATH OF THE KING'S OWN GUARD, IN STEEL.

whisper_wane.name: WHISPER & WANE
whisper_wane.desc: THOUSAND CUTS STRIKES UP TO 10 FOES AND STARTS AGAIN IF THE LAST ONE FALLS. TWO BLADES THAT WERE NEVER MEANT TO BE APART.

skyfall.name: SKYFALL
skyfall.desc: STORM OF TALONS LASTS 8S AND ITS HITS STUN. THE STRING SINGS BEFORE IT'S DRAWN.

first_light.name: HAMMER OF FIRST LIGHT
first_light.desc: DAWNBREAK ALSO BURNS NEARBY FOES WITH HEAVY LIGHT. WARM IN THE HAND, ALWAYS.

worldsplitter.name: WORLDSPLITTER
worldsplitter.desc: PRIMAL FORM LASTS 4S LONGER AND EVERY HIT SLAMS THE GROUND. THE GROUND HAS NOTED THIS AND IS NOT HAPPY.

heart_of_winter.name: HEART OF WINTER
heart_of_winter.desc: FROST. ABSOLUTE ZERO FREEZES BOSSES FOR 3S. THE COLD THAT WAS ALWAYS HERS, GIVEN BACK.

omniwrench.name: OMNIWRENCH
omniwrench.desc: CLANK LASTS 24S AND FIRES ROCKETS. IT FITS EVERY BOLT EVER MADE AND SEVERAL THAT HAVEN'T BEEN YET.

malgrim_cufflink.name: MALGRIM'S CUFFLINK
malgrim_cufflink.desc: +25% DAMAGE, -25% MAX HP. CURSED: IT CAN'T BE SOLD. A SILVER HEX, STILL WARM FROM HIS WRIST.

staff_ninth.name: STAFF OF THE NINTH APPRENTICE
staff_ninth.desc: FIRE. METEOR CALLS DOWN THREE METEORS. MALGRIM KEPT IT FOR THE APPRENTICE WHO WOULD ONE DAY OUTGROW HIM. PIP, AS IT TURNS OUT.

gold_fly_amber.name: GOLD FLY IN AMBER
gold_fly_amber.desc: UNCOLLECTED GOLDEN FLIES SHOW ON THE MAP. A FLY FROM THE OLD DAYS, CAUGHT IN A BEAD OF HONEY-STONE. THE KING CAN'T STOP LOOKING AT IT.

hunters_tooth.name: HUNTER'S TOOTH
hunters_tooth.desc: +15% DAMAGE AGAINST ELITES AND BOUNTIES. TEN BOUNTIES CLAIMED - THE BOARD'S OWN TROPHY, A TOOTH OFF SOMETHING NOBODY WILL NAME.

mirror_truths.name: MIRROR OF TRUTHS
mirror_truths.desc: SHADOW. TURNS BACK ONE PROJECTILE EVERY 5S. MADE FROM THE SHARDS OF HIS MIRRORS, IT SHOWS ONLY WHAT'S REALLY THERE.

fletchers_thumb_ring.name: FLETCHER'S THUMB RING
fletchers_thumb_ring.desc: +6% CRIT, +3 ATK. WYNN'S OWN, WORN SMOOTH BY FORTY YEARS OF BOWSTRINGS. A ROUND OF 44 EARNED IT.

key_brightwater.name: KEY TO BRIGHTWATER
key_brightwater.desc: +10% XP AND GOLD FOR THE WHOLE PARTY. +15 HP. A BRASS KEY THE SIZE OF YOUR HAND. IT DOESN'T OPEN ANYTHING. EVERYONE KNOWS WHAT IT MEANS.
